categories_thin: Martial arts is no longer thin - the dedicated query returned 5 in-zone schools, all now listed with township confirmed by the Census geocoder.
Picture framing: only one in-zone shop (CustomPictureFrames.com); the framing query returned nothing else local.
Shoe repair: the dedicated query returned only shops in Raritan, Old Bridge and Piscataway/Edison - zero inside Franklin Township.
Upholstery: shops found were in South Plainfield, New Brunswick, Milltown and Edison - zero inside the township.
Pet supply retail: only PetSmart locations in zone (chain, excluded); the independent pet-supply shops found are in North Brunswick and Milltown, outside the zone.
Independent hotels: every hotel near Somerset is a national brand (Hilton, Marriott, IHG, Choice, Sonesta, Extended Stay), so zero eligible independents.
Pet boarding / kennels: the only boarding operations nearby are franchise brands (Camp Bow Wow, K9 Resorts, All American Pet Resorts, Best Friends) or sit outside the township.
Music instrument retail: no independent instrument store found in the township; the nearest are chain music stores and shops in Somerville/Raritan.

Child care/education is dominated by franchise brands (KinderCare, The Learning Experience, Goddard, Kumon, JEI, ALOHA), excluded per the chain/franchise rule, so the independent count looks lower than the true provider count.

Wholesale/distribution: most warehouse occupants on Veronica Ave, Belmont Dr and Randolph Rd are branch sites of national companies (e.g. LGE US, Ferguson) and were excluded; only single-site operators are listed.

Dry cleaning was under-covered in the first pass because entries were harvested from a 'tailor alterations' query; a dedicated dry-cleaner query has now been run and added Jem Dry Cleaners and La Ritz Cleaners.
Still not systematically searched: labs, logistics/warehousing specifically, and rep/sales offices - these remain likely under-counts.
caveats: Manufacturing/wholesale rule (now applied uniformly): a plant or warehouse is listed only when the operator appears to be a single-site company. Sites removed this round for documented multi-plant or national-brand ownership: Anvil International (DBA Anvil Services - a national pipe-fittings brand), MRP Solutions (plants in Plattsburgh NY, Twinsburg OH and Chicago per its own site and 2024 sustainability report), United Plastics Group (plants in Houston, Wales and China), Ardena US (ardena.com states 5 facilities and 700+ employees) and MICRO (three Belmont Dr buildings plus a Costa Rica plant per its own facilities page). The earlier pass had also excluded LGE US, Ferguson and Terumo on the same basis. Where ownership beyond the site could not be verified (Falcon Manufacturing, Betar Inc, Ziyad Distribution), the entry is kept and flagged - an evidence gap rather than a different rule.

Food exclusion reading: the exclusion list targets restaurants, retail food, grocers, butchers, liquor and convenience stores. Two B2B operations were therefore kept - W. A. Cleary (specialty food-ingredient manufacturer) and Ziyad Distribution (food import/distribution warehouse). If the intended reading is 'anything food-related', both should be dropped.

Website column: filled by opening each domain or reading it off the business's own Google place page. Four domains could not be content-verified - totaram.com, flowerstation.com and myfamilyappliances.com returned HTTP 403 and lattanziolumber.com returned a script-only page - so those four rest on the domain shown on the listing.

Phones: the numbers shown are what each listing or place page publishes. Several shops genuinely publish no phone (Mattress and Furniture Gallery, Ziyad Distribution, Plaza Cleaners, Evergreen Dry Cleaners, Dependable Cleaners, Albert Gerald Tailor, Shruthi School, The Kulture Collection) and stay 'Unknown'.

Township/zone: Google place pages for several entries print a plus code labelled 'Somerset, Franklin Township, NJ', noted where seen. The five new martial-arts addresses were confirmed with the US Census geocoder (county subdivision = Franklin township). School of the Arts Dance Education Center is the one entry whose township is still unconfirmed.

Home-based businesses: several entries publish a residential-style address (Precious Gifts Daycare, Shruthi School of Music, Rising Star Tutoring, The Print Code, Sumappliances, Accounting and CPA Exam Tutoring, Second Hand Rose). These are the businesses' own published business addresses, recorded as-is with a note.

Google Maps is reachable only in a limited view that caps each query at roughly 4-12 results and will not accept scroll input, so a result page is a sample of the category rather than the full set; repeated queries for the same category returned partially different businesses.
The star ratings and review counts quoted in 'active_evidence' are those shown on the map listing or place page at the time of checking; they are a snapshot and will drift.

Chain/franchise exclusion applied to: KinderCare, The Learning Experience, Goddard School, Kumon, JEI, ALOHA Mind Math, PostNet, The UPS Store, Staples, CVS/Walgreens photo, Mr. Appliance, Home Depot, Walmart, Ferguson, LGE US, Terumo, PetSmart, Camp Bow Wow, K9 Resorts, All American Pet Resorts.

Businesses excluded after address checks placed them outside Franklin Township: Kim's Bike Shop and Redmond's Appliance (New Brunswick), Cambridge Learning Center and Lev Trading (North Brunswick), RUFF CUTS Boutique (North Brunswick), InSpira Performing Arts and Imagine Forever Photo (New Brunswick), Resnick Distributors (New Brunswick), Montgomery Driving School and Pricewise Distributors (North Brunswick/Livingston Ave), Katie's Pet Depot (North Brunswick), One Of The Family Pet Supply (Milltown), Osprey Lane Boutique (Somerville area), La Glamurosa Boutique (New Brunswick), Jemi's Fashionhub (Piscataway area).
data_gaps: Yellow Pages, BBB, Manta, ChamberofCommerce.com and Yelp blocked both the fetch tool and the real Chrome browser (403/Cloudflare) in the earlier pass; they were not re-tested this round, so no bulk directory was mined.
Overpass API timed out in the earlier pass and api.openstreetmap.org returns raw XML too large to parse without shell tooling, so an OSM-derived full inventory was not possible.

Google Maps limited view caps results per query (roughly 4-12) and does not accept scroll/click injection, so sub-categories such as labs, logistics/warehousing and manufacturing are under-counted versus a full directory. Place pages had to be opened one at a time to read website and phone fields, so only the highest-value entries were checked that way.
Not every remaining 'Unknown' phone could be resolved: those listings publish no number, and opening every place page was outside the time available.
No source was found for the ownership of Betar Inc, Falcon Manufacturing or Ziyad Distribution beyond the local site, so the single-site rule could not be tested for them.
Franklin Township Chamber of Commerce membership roster rendered almost empty; the Somerset County Business Partnership member directory was not usable without a search session.
Township is still unconfirmed for School of the Arts Dance Education Center (202 N Center Dr); verify before outreach.

Five manufacturers were dropped under the single-site rule this round (Anvil Services, MRP Solutions, United Plastics Group, Ardena US, MICRO). If the client wants corporate plants as prospects too, they are named in caveats and can be re-added without further research.
